scope: Windows captured pointwise ColorBalance and Levels analysis; no renderer tests

models.levels: gamma=10^(-midtone/100); low=255*shadow/100, high=255*highlight/100. Forward when high>=low: clamp((input-low)/max(1,high-low))^gamma. Inverted when high<low: 1-clamp((input-high)/(low-high))^gamma. Scale255 and half-up round. Both bounds0 => all255.
models.draw: GDI+ input and output normalization: associated=floor((channel*alpha+127)/255), reciprocal=floor((255*65536)/alpha), straight=floor(associated*reciprocal/65536); alpha0 RGB0. Bitmap intrinsic includes input+output association, DrawImage capture includes a second output association.

limits: Models established on captured parameter grid; not proof of all SDK integer combinations.
Native GDI+ versions and exact numeric intermediates are not inferred from equal outputs.
